sources.entry: Bigcapital - Financial accounting and inventory management software for small to medium businesses. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Bigcapital is an open-source online accounting and inventory management software for small and medium businesses, self-hostable with Docker.
summary.what_it_does: Bigcapital is described as an accounting and inventory software that keeps business finances in one place and automates accounting processes. It is said to produce financial statements and reports to support decision-making. The README says it can be self-hosted on your own servers using Docker and Docker Compose, with a separate Docker guide linked from the docs. It also offers a local development setup and a Gitpod workflow for development. The README states the API can be integrated with other systems to record transactions in a double-entry system, which it calls headless accounting. Documentation, an API reference, a bug tracker, and a Discord are linked as resources.
how_to_run: Follow the Docker guide linked in the README to run self-hosted with Docker and Docker Compose
For development, follow the Local Setup guide in the README
Alternatively, open the project in Gitpod using the button in the README
notable: Headless accounting: API can be used to record double-entry transactions in external systems
Self-hosted under AGPL license with Docker support
caveats: Commercial inquiries are directed to a sales team; a hosted Bigcapital Cloud offering is referenced
README gives no details on system requirements or database setup
